notes: A pack groups reviewed hub files for deterministic project registration. Only packs with confirmed provenance and redistribution permission are listed. Installing a pack never enables a service or spends money.

engineering-sdk.summary: Versioned offline integrity, deployment identity and release guards plus read-only MCP discovery.
requires: git for target and release checks
engineering-sdk.origin: Owner-authorized original engineering tooling in this hub. Review at an immutable merged SHA; no third-party runtime dependencies.

motion-sdk.summary: Universal Motion SDK with 400 original Canvas2D reference scenes, local examples and scoped MIT licenses; no provider or optional rendering engine dependencies.
requires: Node.js 20+ for deterministic scene sampling, or a browser with Canvas2D
motion-sdk.origin: Owner-authorized original MIT source in packages/motion-sdk and motion-library/expansion, copied by checksum from one reviewed merged hub SHA with both scoped license files. Relative imports are preserved; no npm packages, remote textures, model calls or paid rendering services are installed.
motion-sdk.limits: Canvas2D reference scenes only. Studio, browser binaries, GPU engines, encoded video and production performance evidence are not installed by this pack.

motion-runtime.summary: Dependency-free browser runtime for hub motion specifications, with the logical-direction base stylesheet.
requires: a browser with the Web Animations API
motion-runtime.origin: Implemented and reviewed in this public hub; copied by checksum from the pinned hub revision.

headroom-context.summary: Optional local Headroom context preparation with durable SHA256 originals and bounded verified retrieval; no provider calls or native host interception.
requires: Linux x86_64 or aarch64 with libseccomp.so.2 for optimization; unsupported boundaries pass through
Python 3.11+; reviewed closure tested on CPython 3.12 Linux x86_64
Optional separately installed headroom-ai==0.45.0; no automatic installation
headroom-context.origin: Owner-authorized local launcher plus shared instructions, copied from one reviewed merged hub commit. Audited Python dependencies are downloaded separately with exact versions and hashes; no third-party library binaries are redistributed in this pack.
headroom-context.limits: Selective development tool only; no proxy, wrapper, MCP registration, authentication changes, live model session, production runtime dependency or measured billing savings.

gaie-factory.summary: GAIE software factory for a project: bilingual master router with the project registry, build/upgrade/audit/cinematic/release skills, master prompts, the unified private project memory engine and read-only inventory.
gaie-factory.origin: Owner-authorized original engineering tooling in this hub, standard library only. Review at an immutable merged SHA; no third-party dependencies.
gaie-factory.limits: Development-time instructions and local tools only. Routing is deterministic lexical matching; no model, provider or deployment call, no agent daemon, no production runtime dependency. Host discovery and invocation of the skills need separate evidence in each environment.
